title: Releasing Bushels Out of Store on a Signed Load-Out Order
content:
Grain leaves store on a released order, and the bushels that actually move are worked out against what is free rather than against what the member asked for. This entry governs releases under Grain Storage and Conditioning Agreements.

## Clause

The bushels an order releases are fixed only once the bushels standing free on the agreement, the bushels on hand that are not pledged against an outstanding warehouse receipt, reach the programme's load-out minimum.

The bushels an order releases are fixed only after the storage account carries a shrink line raised no earlier than the most recent conditioning charge standing on it.

The bushels moving out are then recorded against the load-out request named, and those bushels come off what the storage account shows in store from that moment. The money side of the account is untouched, and the agreement keeps its standing, its grade of record and whatever remains pledged on it.

## The two clauses restated

Until the bushels on hand that are not pledged against an outstanding warehouse receipt stand at the programme's load-out minimum or above it, the quantity an order releases is not yet fixed.

Until the most recent shrink line on the storage account stands no earlier in date than the most recent conditioning charge on it, the quantity an order releases is not yet fixed either. Both readings are taken from the records as they stand.

## Running the release

The tool is `release_loadout_bushels_2fb9cebd`, and it is the member's own: the desk unlocks it and hands it over for the customer themselves to run, taking grain home being the member's act rather than the elevator's.

### Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Form |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `agreement_id` | the internal reference number of the storage agreement the grain is coming out of | as returned by the storage agreement lookup for this member |
| `request_id` | the internal reference number of the signed load-out request the order is worked against | as returned by the storage service request lookup |
| `bushels` | the quantity actually moving out of store | bushels to 2 decimal places, rounded half up at the second decimal, never negative |

### What comes back

A single line of confirmation text carrying the new storage account line's own reference, the load-out request it was worked against and the bushels moved, in bushels to 2 decimal places. Receiving that line means the grain is recorded as out of store and the bushels are off what the storage account shows in store.

## Notes for the desk

**Does the money side of the account move?** It does not. What moves is the quantity the account shows in store.

**Does what remains pledged change?** No. The agreement keeps whatever remains pledged on it.
